candidates.title: Reflected XSS via unescaped innerHTML sink
candidates.rationale: req.query.msg flows directly into innerHTML with no encoding, so an attacker-supplied ?msg=<script> or an event-handler payload executes in the victim's browser origin.

candidates.title: Remote code execution via eval on request body
candidates.rationale: req.body.expr is passed straight to eval, giving any caller arbitrary JavaScript execution in the server process, including require/process access.
candidates.evidence:
const expr = req.body.expr;
const result = eval(expr);

candidates.title: SQL injection via string concatenation in db.query
candidates.rationale: req.params.id is concatenated into the SQL string inside single quotes, so a value like ' OR '1'='1 rewrites the WHERE clause and allows full data exfiltration or stacked queries depending on driver settings.
candidates.evidence:
const id = req.params.id;
return db.query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = '" + id + "'");
